reviews.review: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine is definitely the best game of last month and maybe the best game of 2015 (if you close your eyes and forget about Deus Ex: Human Revolution that is). Kratos from God of War has been dethroned, badassery has a name and its name is Titus. Play it, you will have a unique experience. 10/10 also better with three friends

[h1]"Hope is the first step on the road to disappointment"[/h1]
[i]-Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War loading screen[/i]

Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine is a generic third person action shooter. You take the role of a hardass white guy and meander through a series of narrow passageways that open up every 10 yards or so into a little shooting arena that fills with orks, who you then murder en masse so that you can hurry on to the next corridor or cutscene. 

Even on Hard difficulty, this was so easy that it couldn't keep my interest enough to play all the way through. And it's not like I'm some god tier click-on-mans guy - just ask my TF2 teammates. The idea is probably that you're supposed to feel super badass chewing through hundreds of guys, mashing melee attack and spraying automatic weapons until the swarm of green turns into a pink mist. If that's your jam, more power to you, though I found it rather jejune.

Voiceacting is just as ♥♥♥♥♥♥ as any other Warhammer game. Tough dudes saying gruff one-liners, angry orks repeating the exact same voice clip about how they are going to shoot you over and over, that sort of thing. WH40K has always been over the top but the RTS games did it to the point where it was [url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cO3MttgvHUY]wacky and fun[/url]. This is just a boring b-movie action flick.

Graphics already look pretty dated, even though the game's only a few years old at this point. Color palette is just as brown and washed-out as any 2000's era shooter.

I very much want to like Warhammer 40k. Anything in the universe at all. But the tabletop game is tedious and only sperglords play it, the RTSes are basically only good for a one-time run through of the single-player campaign, and this is just a huge pile of meh. Your time is better spent elsewhere.

3/10
This game cost me $4 per minute, 10/10 wound recommend.

[h1]Single-player Campaign Review[/h1]
A fun third-person shooter + melee hack-and-slash game. In the game, you are a powerful Space Marine, you serve only the Emperor, and you slaughter enemies of the Imperium.

You have a variety of weapons to choose from and some of them are really epic, especially the rocket jet packs. The story does have some incredible moments mixed in it, complemented by great characters and superb voice acting, and all the boss battles are unique and different.

The story and atmosphere of the game are good and stayed true to the Warhammer 40,000 universe. The gameplay and controls are fairly straightforward too, so it’s easy for anyone to just jump in and have some fun.

All in all, this game is highly recommended for fans of the Warhammer 40,000 universe. If you are not a fan, who cares what you think, you are a heretic and you are an absolute disgrace to the Emperor! Just kidding, for people that are unfamiliar with the Warhammer 40,000 universe, this game is worth a look if you are looking for a hack-and-slash game to have some fun with.

"Success is measured in blood; yours or your enemy's."

40,000/10 would purge in the name of the Emperor again
